title: Prom and Recipe
author: Juniper Nystrom
blurb: Wendell Amberdale, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
